newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates narrow, one week down.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates narrow, one week down.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed in a moderate private-sector market on Tuesday to 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent from Monday's range of 7-1/2 and nine percent, bankers said.
One week rates fell to between seven and 7-1/2 percent from 7-1/2 to 7-3/4 percent on Monday.
Bankers said there were not many one week deals because of the Moslem holiday of Eid al-Adha between April 17-19.
The public sector retained its lending rate at 10-1/2 percent.
